title: Mom's questions
lede: Everything Nicholas needs from you, in one place: two short parts for the new websites and five short parts for the family picture. Answer in your own words, in any order, over as many sittings as you like. Each part sends itself to Nicholas a few seconds after you stop typing (watch for the green Sent line) and keeps a copy on your phone. If you don't know, tap Not sure or Ask Dad and move on. Never type an account number, password or Social Security number here: tap In person.

sections.title: 1. Upper Deck website (what's left)
sections.lead: Two questions; the rest were answered on September 9.

qs.t: Four items marked "fixed prices": L434, UAL128, UDXL201, UT906. What should each show?
qs.w: "Fixed" didn't tell us the number. Type the right single price and, if there is one, the right quantity price (example: 27.50 / 4+ 26.50), or ONE if there should be no quantity price.

qs.t: Anything you would change in Veronica's answers?
qs.w: She ruled on September 9: $250 counted after quantity discounts (never shipping) and $75 for showroom pickup · no card taken on the website, charged once when the order ships, net-30 accounts by check · every Min. item: the minimum, then any number · orders sync into the office system (LMS, backup VXP) · no one sees prices or orders until approved · hours Mon–Thu 8–3 · keep the checkout pickup switch, drop the cart question.

sections.title: 2. Moby Dick website (what's left)
sections.lead: Two questions; the first ten were answered on September 9.

qs.t: The 41 MR resin figures: for each one, ONE price only, or type the quantity prices
qs.w: Their quantity prices were taken off in August because the printed book doesn't have them. Price now = what the old website charges today. Type ONE for one price only, or the quantity prices (example: 12+ 3.25).
cols: Old quantity prices (if we have them)

qs.w: On the new Moby Dick website every old account came over as approved, because the file we had for Moby Dick did not say who was approved and who had only registered. Upper Deck's file did. To fix Moby Dick we need the real list.
